source_gap_claims.behavior: A local-only Skill declares that external API and version lookup are not applicable.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations contain no declaration requirement for local-only Skills to mark external API/version lookup as not applicable.
source_gap_claims.subject: Local-only Skill declaration

source_gap_claims.behavior: A local-only Skill validates without Context7, MCP connections, or network access.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires local-only validation to operate without these external services.
source_gap_claims.subject: Local-only Skill validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: A local fixture without network configuration passes validation, while a local-only declaration that includes a network or API dependency fails.
source_gap_claims.reason: The complete obligation set lacks this local-only positive case and contradictory-dependency rejection.
source_gap_claims.subject: Local-only fixture validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: A version-sensitive Skill declares Context7-first lookup when Context7 is available.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation specifies Context7-first lookup for version-sensitive Skills.
source_gap_claims.subject: Version-sensitive lookup policy

source_gap_claims.behavior: A version-sensitive Skill declares an official HTTPS fallback when Context7 is unavailable.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires an official HTTPS fallback for unavailable Context7 lookup.
source_gap_claims.subject: Version-sensitive lookup policy

source_gap_claims.behavior: A version-sensitive Skill records the version, source, and retrieval date for lookup information.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations do not require version, source, and retrieval-date provenance records.
source_gap_claims.subject: Version-sensitive provenance records

source_gap_claims.behavior: A version-sensitive Skill declares behavior for missing or stale information.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires a missing-information or stale-information policy.
source_gap_claims.subject: Version-sensitive information policy

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation rejects missing version, source, or retrieval-date records.
source_gap_claims.reason: The complete obligation set has no negative validation duty for absent version-sensitive provenance fields.
source_gap_claims.subject: Version-sensitive provenance validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation rejects an HTTP fallback for version-sensitive lookup.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation prohibits downgrade from HTTPS for this lookup path.
source_gap_claims.subject: Version-sensitive fallback validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation rejects an arbitrary nonofficial fallback for version-sensitive lookup.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations do not require fallback sources to be official or reject arbitrary nonofficial sources.
source_gap_claims.subject: Version-sensitive fallback validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Historical version-sensitive records are treated as syntax and provenance inputs rather than proof of current latest versions.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation defines this limitation on the evidentiary meaning of historical records.
source_gap_claims.subject: Historical lookup records

source_gap_claims.behavior: Static validation performs no Context7, HTTPS, or other version lookup.
source_gap_claims.reason: The complete obligation set does not prohibit lookup execution during static validation.
source_gap_claims.subject: Static validator lookup behavior

source_gap_claims.behavior: A secret-using capability declares its runtime credential owner.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires secret-using capabilities to identify their runtime credential owner.
source_gap_claims.subject: Secret capability declaration

source_gap_claims.behavior: A secret-using capability declares a safe credential reference mechanism.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations do not require a safe reference mechanism for runtime credentials.
source_gap_claims.subject: Secret capability declaration

source_gap_claims.behavior: A secret-using capability declares a redaction policy and denied output locations.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires capability-specific redaction rules or denied output locations.
source_gap_claims.subject: Secret output policy

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation rejects synthetic literal credential fields or known secret markers in a secret-capability declaration.
source_gap_claims.reason: The complete obligation set lacks this fixture-level secret-marker rejection.
source_gap_claims.subject: Secret declaration validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation rejects a secret-using capability with no credential owner.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires a missing credential owner to fail validation.
source_gap_claims.subject: Secret declaration validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation rejects a raw secret-output policy.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations do not require rejection of declarations permitting raw secret output.
source_gap_claims.subject: Secret output policy validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Secret-related diagnostics report only the rule and location and do not expose credential values.
source_gap_claims.reason: Existing diagnostics obligations do not establish this secret-specific disclosure restriction.
source_gap_claims.subject: Secret diagnostic reporting

source_gap_claims.behavior: Tests do not use real credential fixtures.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation prohibits real credential fixtures in secret-capability validation.
source_gap_claims.subject: Secret fixture policy

source_gap_claims.behavior: The standard makes no universal claim that it detects every secret.
source_gap_claims.reason: The complete obligation set lacks this explicit scope limitation on secret detection.
source_gap_claims.subject: Secret detection scope

source_gap_claims.behavior: A destructive operation declares its affected scope.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires destructive-operation declarations to identify affected scope.
source_gap_claims.subject: Destructive-operation declaration

source_gap_claims.behavior: A destructive operation declares its required confirmation or authorization source.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations do not require destructive operations to identify the confirmation or authorization source.
source_gap_claims.subject: Destructive-operation authorization

source_gap_claims.behavior: A destructive operation discloses recovery information or irreversibility.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires recovery or irreversibility disclosure for destructive operations.
source_gap_claims.subject: Destructive-operation disclosure

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation rejects a destructive-operation declaration with missing affected scope.
source_gap_claims.reason: The complete obligation set lacks this destructive-operation scope failure case.
source_gap_claims.subject: Destructive-operation validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation rejects a bypass flag for a destructive operation.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation prohibits bypass flags in destructive-operation declarations.
source_gap_claims.subject: Destructive-operation validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation rejects confirmation derived solely from untrusted input.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations do not require confirmation provenance to exclude solely untrusted input.
source_gap_claims.subject: Destructive-operation authorization

source_gap_claims.behavior: Existing session or user authorization is accepted when the owning policy recognizes it.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation defines this valid authorization path for destructive operations.
source_gap_claims.subject: Destructive-operation authorization

source_gap_claims.behavior: The standard does not add redundant confirmation requirements to every destructive operation beyond the owning policy.
source_gap_claims.reason: The complete obligation set lacks this constraint against imposing an extra universal confirmation step.
source_gap_claims.subject: Destructive-operation confirmation policy
